statusNote: VALIDATED by the PR7A.0 toolchain proof: the pinned Chadwick cwevent was run over real, SHA-verified 2019 Retrosheet event files (GitHub Actions, no production secrets, no deploy/DB/Railway/runtime/model change) and its output was compared against the fixtures. parserVersion and parserArguments are now pinned to the exact proven toolchain; the raw-shape contract (grammar, interruption '.', responsible-batter attribution, handedness resolution) matches real output and all 8 fixtures pass the revised contract comparison (see fixtures/retrosheetDiscipline/CONTRACT_COMPARISON_RESULT.json). SCOPE OF VALIDATION: parser identity + raw-shape/normalization contract only. It does NOT validate the 2000+ training floor or the 2000-2025 season matrix, both of which remain gated below and require measurement in the authorized environment.

toolchainProof.grammarCrossCheck: frozen token table reproduced cwevent BALLS_CT/STRIKES_CT on 5561/5561 complete real PAs (rate 1.0)
toolchainProof.note: Only minimal source excerpts, hashes, and per-game proof CSVs are committed; the full Retrosheet archive and the full-season CSV are NOT committed (the full-season CSV lives only in the run's uploaded artifact).

purpose: Validated source + parser identity for PR7A Retrosheet plate-discipline capture. Semantic authority + executable parser identity are pinned to the toolchain proven in PR7A.0.

dataSource.name: Retrosheet play-by-play event files
dataSource.commercialUse: permitted with the required Retrosheet attribution notice; raw-data resale prohibited; derived model output permitted
dataSource.attributionNotice: The information used here was obtained free of charge from and is copyrighted by Retrosheet. Interested parties may contact Retrosheet at www.retrosheet.org.

maps.RESP_BAT_ID: responsible batter (original batter on a two-strike substitution; distinct from completing BAT_ID)
maps.REMOVED_FOR_PH_BAT_ID: batter removed for a pinch hitter mid-PA
maps.RESP_BAT_HAND_CD: responsible batter handedness (switch-hitter resolved vs actual pitcher)

parser.name: Chadwick cwevent
parser.note: Pinned to the exact toolchain proven in PR7A.0 (built from source on a clean GitHub Actions runner). The runbook-required semantic fields (PITCH_SEQ_TX, RESP_BAT_ID, RESP_BAT_HAND_CD, RESP_PIT_ID, RESP_PIT_HAND_CD, EVENT_CD, BAT_LINEUP_ID, count fields) are STANDARD cwevent fields in 0.10.0, emitted via -f; -x extended fields are not required for this contract.

seasonWindow.reason: PROVISIONAL — UNCHANGED by PR7A.0/PR7A.1. PITCH_SEQ_TX completeness is BELIEVED strong from ~2000, but this is not empirically verified until the season matrix is measured. The PR7A.0 proof validated the parser + raw-shape contract on a 2019 sample; it did NOT measure multi-season coverage. Treat 2000+ as a working assumption, not a proven floor.
seasonWindow.seasonMatrix2000_2025: PENDING_MEASUREMENT — UNCHANGED by PR7A.0/PR7A.1. Must be produced by running the pinned parser over the licensed dataset in the authorized environment; values must never be fabricated (see contract §3.6). The 2000+ floor is confirmed or corrected ONLY by this matrix.

floors.belowFloorPolicy: affected derived rate is null with an explicit reason; raw counts always preserved

prohibitedInputs: any pitch coordinate or zone proxy
